en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view tourist postcard showing scenes from the Romanian spa resort Călimănești: panoramic views of a valley town by wooded hills, a grand hotel with steep roofs, a riverside villa with a sailboat, a park pavilion/gazebo, and forested parkland. The title "CĂLIMĂNEȘTI" appears vertically on the picture side. The back has Romanian layout text, a Romanian stamp (40 Bani, Posta Română) depicting a lizard (Ablepharus kitaibelii fitzingeri), and a 1968 cancellation. Addressed in Romanian to an addressee in Brăila on Bulevardul Karl Marx.
